messages.subject: Aquatic birds
parts:
Dear list,

=20

I=B4m trying to calculate density of aquatic birds in rice fields with =
different growing stages (I'll call them "habitats"). There are several =
questions I am trying to solve, however, some of some issues remain =
unclear to me.

=20

The survey was carried out using point transects of 500 meters between =
points. With an irregular number of points per transect and in some =
cases there are complete points and other are half points (this is =
solved with the point effort at the points). Distances were measures =
using regular intervals of 10 m up to 150 m (grouped data).

=20

1) There are only 10 species with more than 30 observations when pooling =
the data for two countries and post- stratifying them by habitat. It is =
right to post stratify like this?

=20

2) The people who did the survey told me that they took into account =
birds before they flew away, however, I have run the analysis for =
several species and the first intervals have less individuals (if not =
any) compared to distances out to about 100 m. In some of the analysis =
the GOF test is low and I don't realize which model I must choose...

How can I realize if this is a situation of evasive movement of birds o =
if it is due to the nature of point transect data at low distances? Do I =
have to left-truncate?=20



I've read Chapter 5 related to this in Buckland et al. 2001, but I was =
wondering if others have experiences with similar problems and if anyone =
has suggestions regarding analysis of these data.

=20

Thank you!

=20

Andrea.

=20
